preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices n in each test case must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each ancestor b[i] must be a valid vertex index between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: len(set(p)) == n and all(1 <= p[i] <= n for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: The permutation p must contain n unique integers, each between 1 and n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' or all(1 <= w[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n) if w[i] != 0)
postconditions.description: If a solution exists, the output weights must be positive integers not exceeding 10^9, except for the root.

postconditions.expression: all(dist[p[i]] < dist[p[i+1]] for i in range(n-1))
postconditions.description: The distances from the root to the vertices must be in increasing order according to the permutation p.
The weight of the edge leading to the root must be 0.
